mapper.select: SELECT W.WISHLIST_ID, W.USER_NO, W.PRODUCT_ID, W.CREATED_AT, P.TITLE, P.PRICE, P.TRADE_TYPE, P.STATUS, PM.THUMBNAIL_URL AS MAIN_IMAGE, TO_CHAR(W.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS WISHED_AT_STR FROM WISHLISTS W JOIN PRODUCTS P ON W.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_MEDIA PM ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PM.PRODUCT_ID AND PM.MEDIA_ORDER = 1 WHERE W.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND P.FIELD = 0 ORDER BY W.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT RV.VIEW_ID, RV.USER_NO, RV.PRODUCT_ID, RV.VIEWED_AT, P.TITLE, P.PRICE, P.STATUS, PM.THUMBNAIL_URL AS MAIN_IMAGE, TO_CHAR(RV.VIEWED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS VIEWED_AT_STR FROM RECENT_VIEWS RV JOIN PRODUCTS P ON RV.PRODUCT_ID = RV.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_MEDIA PM ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PM.PRODUCT_ID AND PM.MEDIA_ORDER = 1 WHERE RV.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND P.FIELD = 0 ORDER BY RV.VIEWED_AT DESC
